fields.definition: Parkinsonism effect status for this follow-up encounter: present, absent or unresolved assessment requiring clinician review of bradykinesia/akinesia, rigidity or parkinsonian tremor with medication relationship, onset and alternative explanations plus SAS measurement context when the complete reviewed source is available.
fields.operationalization: Present requires clinician-recorded bradykinesia/akinesia, rigidity or parkinsonian tremor with medication timeline and onset review plus alternative explanations considered; Absent requires assessment finding no such syndrome; Unresolved/not_assessed/unknown means assessment incomplete or conflicting and pauses. SAS item responses are measurement context only when the complete reviewed source is available; no etiology is inferred from an unreviewed SAS total or mean and no mild/moderate/severe bands are created. Page notes are never mapping input.
fields.provenance_contract: Clinician-entered structured category with encounter/window, author attribution and assessment record; copied baseline requires reconciliation. Page notes are never mapping input.
fields.source_locator: project-documents/medical-documents/parkinsonism-criteria.md — Diagnostic features (bradykinesia/akinesia, rigidity, parkinsonian tremor; onset commonly within weeks) and Clinical assessment and exclusions

fields.definition: Whether parkinsonism is associated with antipsychotic exposure in this follow-up context, after alternative explanations are considered.
fields.operationalization: Established requires documented antipsychotic exposure with onset within weeks of initiation or escalation and alternative contributors reviewed; NotEstablished requires assessment finding no such association or an alternative explanation. Unknown pauses. Exposure agents and windows only; no dose/route/frequency. Page notes are never mapping input.

purpose: Isolated S35 review proposal; not loaded by runtime, not replacing or approving v1. No medication regimen fields. Effect present/absent/not_assessed gates applicability with reviewed severity; SAS item responses are measurement context only pending the complete reviewed source; no etiology from unreviewed total, no universal severity bands, and no treatment threshold.
retained_history_v1: Twelve original v1 fields and runtime remain unchanged; this separately versioned adjunct proposes 13 additional CPT-context categories for F3 plus one parallel urgent NMS-triage banner field with no network mapping, none approved.
